direction-type.words: Welcome to the Corona Canon Project!
The short version: create your own series of four-measure melodies using the provided chords.
You will hear playback from the invisible piano and cello staves (you can disable this in the Mixer if you prefer).
Replace "Your name here" above with your name as you want it to appear in the completed composition.
Upload your version of the score to musescore.com and add it to the Corona Canon Project group.
The melodies will be assembled into a collaborative composition.
